# Testing-scope review — fictional classroom exercise

This is a discussion document, not actual authorisation.
Authority to verify: responsible teacher/system owner for the local training app.
Target: teacher-owned local training app with synthetic loan records, supplied account roles, supplied logs/configuration.
Permitted: read-only review of provided material; checks using supplied accounts according to teacher instructions.
Excluded: production school portal, other students' devices, real personal data/credentials, disruptive tests, external publication.
Window/contact/stop rule: defined by the teacher before any actual lab; stop when an unexpected out-of-scope system or data appears; report via the agreed contact.
Evidence: minimum necessary synthetic screenshots/log extracts in the approved evidence-storage location; do not publish externally without separate authority.

Classify and justify:
A. Review the supplied training log.
B. Scan the production portal because a classmate says it is okay.
C. Check a supplied read-only account against the agreed training permissions.
D. Explore an unexpected production link to see how much real data is accessible.
E. Publish the supplied log on a public forum.
F. Record a minimal synthetic finding and recommend remediation through the agreed contact.

For actual testing, confirm valid authority, precise scope/methods/time, stop conditions and data handling before acting.
